evidence: Amine catalysts can reduce the high temperatures and long exposure times required for SiO 2 atomic layer deposition ~ALD! using SiCl4 and H2O reactants. This study investigated catalyzed SiO 2 ALD on BaTiO3 and ZrO2 particles using alternating exposures of tetraethoxysilane ~TEOS! and H2O at 300 K with NH3 as the catalyst.
